name: Debt payoff comparison
audience: People with two or three consumer debts who want a payment order before they call a credit provider.
summary: Compare minimum payments with a snowball order and an avalanche order for three debts.
description: See this month's interest and a months-to-clear estimate for each debt if you keep paying the current minimum. A second estimate shows the effect of putting one extra amount onto the highest-rate debt.
benefits: See interest building this month on each balance
Estimate months left at the current minimum
See the shorter estimate when extra money goes to the highest rate
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
